concepts.name: Veri Penceresi
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a new original symbol-only logo concept for Veri_Ufku, a friendly professional offline Linux desktop data exploration application. One centered logo on a square genuinely transparent canvas, generous margins. Refined flat vector-like graphic, bold simple geometry, crisp smooth edges, opaque solid colors, memorable at small sizes. No text, captions, letters, watermarks, mockups, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, 3D, checkerboard, or painted background. Intended application background #151722. Concept: an open rounded-square window frame with a deliberate gap at upper right. Inside it, three thick ascending bars are aligned on a common baseline, separated by ample transparent negative space. The frame is lavender #C3A6EF; the three bars are mint #91D7B2. Make frame and bars feel like one coherent compact emblem of finding insight through a window. No tiny chart ticks, gridlines, axes or extra decorations.
